mir.text: Mangara is a wise man from Corondor who won the loyalty of the Quirion centuries ago by supporting their independence rather than ruling their minds. In Mirage, he meets Jolrael and Kaervek on Teferi's Isle, and then brokers peace among the rival nations of Jamuraa, settling the Zhalfir-Femeref border with a buffer zone of Quirion elves.

Kaervek resents the peace and persuades Jolrael that Mangara plans domination, so Kaervek and Jolrael ambush Mangara in the Mwonvuli Delta and seal him in an Amber Prison. Kaervek then claims he has taken Mangara's power.

Teferi sends visions to Jamuraa, and Asmira leads the expedition to recover the imprisoned Mangara, together with Rashida Scalebane, Sidar Jabari and Hakim Loreweaver. Asmira is slain by Purraj of Urborg while freeing Mangara, and is named the Holy Avenger posthumously.
Once free, Mangara, with Quirion and Mundungu allies, defeats Kaervek and locks him in the Amber Prison.

vis.text: In Visions, Asmira leads Scalebane's elite to free Mangara from the amber prison where Kaervek jealously imprisoned him. Her prayers alone should have freed him, but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.
Mangara then confronts Kaervek's arrogance, asking whether he did not know the price he would pay.
